# Pally.gg script functions

Functions for C# (`Cb.Call`) and Python (a `cb` method each, or `cb.call`). See [Script functions](index.md) for how to use them.

## pally.isConnected

Checks whether Cuebot is connected to Pally.gg right now.

**Gives back:** true while connected, otherwise false.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("pally.isConnected");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.pally_is_connected()
    ```

## pally.sendTestEvent

Fakes a Pally.gg campaign tip inside Cuebot, so you can test your triggers. Nothing is sent to Pally.gg and it works without a connection.

| Value | In Python | What to put in |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `kind` | Optional. Which event. Only "campaignTip" exists, and it is the default. |

**Gives back:** true when the test tip was sent, false when the kind is unknown.

=== "C#"

    ```csharp
    var answer = await Cb.Call("pally.sendTestEvent");
    ```

=== "Python"

    ```python
    answer = cb.pally_send_test_event()
    ```
